entities.summary: The reorganized National Government of the Republic of China, commonly described as the Wang Jingwei regime, was a puppet government of the Empire of Japan in eastern China. It existed coterminously with the Nationalist government of the Republic of China under Chiang Kai-shek, which was fighting Japan alongside the other Allies of World War II. The country functioned as a dictatorship under Wang Jingwei, formerly a high-ranking official of the Kuomintang (KMT) party. The region it administered had been seized by Japan in the late 1930s at the beginning of the Second Sino-Japanese War.
